has_active_subject.reason: HAS_ACTIVE_SUBJECT is an Atom-to-declared-entity-or-instance Relation. Its exclusion of literal values and glyphs remains correct; the new value Relation exceptions must not widen this unrelated Relation.

domain_and_syntax_notes: Generic endpoint variables in Relation Declarations range over their explicit Relation-specific domain; R2814 candidate admits literal/constraint data only for the two value Relation pairs. No Value Node or novel endpoint type syntax.
Prospective typed Relation-object bindings and alias($relation) follow the pending CFEL successor grammar; source headers still use existing native Subject syntax until coordinated migration.
Endpoint permission/default-zero effects need separate source review; declaring an inverse does not grant outgoing inverse permissions.
Only HAS_ALLOWED_VALUE and HAS_VALUE_CONSTRAINT aggregate by OR and AND respectively; no other Relation receives this policy.
The original no-operator-entity removal in R2247 is retained while its outdated descriptor reference is removed.
limits: No native Current or Draft, code, tests, Workflow, Workbench or Git mutation.

generic_signature_candidate.scope: Only within Relation Declarations; literal/constraint endpoint allowance limited to the two value Relation pairs.

qualified_scope_decision: Qualified Subjects retain := admission and selection, including Atom//(.Role := Method); allowed-value OR aggregation within that scope never removes its selection condition.
signature_grouping: Generic Relation Declaration endpoint signatures are model constraints under # model; they are not authored instance facts.
